PURBASHA GRAMIN BANK
(A fictional bank) · Ranchi Branch

Date: 18.10.2026

To,
Joseph Mondal
101, Main Road, Ranchi, Jharkhand - 834001

Sub: Reminder for overdue instalments in Loan Account No. 254986200082

Dear Customer,

This is to inform you that 1 EMI(s) of ₹ 12,450.00 each in your above loan account are overdue since 09.09.2026. The total overdue amount is ₹ 12,450.00, and penal interest of ₹ 249.00 has been levied as per the sanction terms.

You are requested to pay ₹ 12,699.00 on or before 25.10.2026 to regularise the account.

Please note that if the dues are not cleared, the account will be classified as a Non-Performing Asset (NPA) on 08.12.2026, which will affect your credit score, and the Bank may initiate recovery proceedings as per law.

If you have already paid, please ignore this letter.

Yours faithfully,
Branch Manager
